gameID.description: The unique ID linking this pack to its base game engine context (e.g., 'core').

setID.description: The lowercase ID of the card set this pack pulls from.

packID.description: The unique internal identification code for this specific pack/booster profile.

name.description: The user-facing display name printed on the shop wrapper interface.

front.description: The relative file path to the booster pack wrapper's front texture asset.

back.description: The relative file path to the booster pack wrapper's back texture asset.

color.description: The RGB color values used by the game engine to tint background glows or text elements.

contents.description: The weighted distribution pool of cards obtainable from this pack. Can be left empty ([]) but the key must be present.

cardID.description: The internal string ID of the target card.

weight.description: The relative pull weight determining gacha drop rates for this card inside the pack.
